approval_boundary.approval_scope: The supplied commit and SHA-256 are out-of-band controller/reviewer authorization, not self-authenticating caller input.
approval_boundary.task7_responsibility: Durably sign approval, isolate and terminate workers, and retain an append-only execution receipt.

protocol.stopping_rule: If v3.4 fails either preregistered target threshold or its evidence-validity hard gate, no further Task 6 confirmatory attempt will be opened; later work is exploratory or belongs to Task 7 evaluation.
